ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon (Earth Estries / GhostEmperor) DLL side-loading — signed vendor host binary executing from ProgramData/Public staging path
ucs.description: Hunts for legitimate signed third-party utilities that Earth Estries and GhostEmperor repeatedly abuse to side-load DEMODEX, GHOSTSPIDER, SNAPPYBEE, and ZINGDOOR loader DLLs (dthelper.exe/DigitalPersona, K7SysMSI.exe/K7TSecurity.exe/K7 Computing, avp.exe/Kaspersky, rc.exe/Trend Micro, vftrace.exe/VMware) running from non-default staging paths (\ProgramData\, \Users\Public\, \Windows\Temp\, \PerfLogs\). The combination of the binary identity and the non-vendor path is the Salt Typhoon fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("dthelper.exe","k7sysmsi.exe","k7tsecurity.exe","avp.exe","rc.exe","vftrace.exe") (Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\PerfLogs\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") NOT (Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Program Files (x86)\\*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let SaltTyphoonAbusedHosts = dynamic(["dthelper.exe","k7sysmsi.exe","k7tsecurity.exe","avp.exe","rc.exe","vftrace.exe"]);
let StagingPaths = dynamic([@"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\", @"\appdata\local\temp\"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ (SaltTyphoonAbusedHosts)                       // signed vendor binary identity (case-insensitive)
| where tolower(FolderPath) has_any (StagingPaths)                  // running from a Salt Typhoon staging path
| where not(tolower(FolderPath) startswith @"c:\program files")   // exclude legitimate install location
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                                   // strip machine accounts
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SignedHost = FileName, SignedHostPath = FolderPath, SHA256,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          VendorCompany = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SaltTyphoonAbusedHosts = dynamic(["dthelper.exe","k7sysmsi.exe","k7tsecurity.exe","avp.exe","rc.exe","vftrace.exe"]);
let StagingPaths = dynamic([@"\programdata\", @"\users\public\", @"\windows\temp\", @"\perflogs\", @"\appdata\local\temp\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImagePathLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| extend ProcLeaf = tostring(split(ImagePathLower, "\\")[-1])
| where ProcLeaf in (SaltTyphoonAbusedHosts)
| where ImagePathLower has_any (StagingPaths)
| where not(ImagePathLower startswith @"c:\program files")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon DLL Side-Load Host Binary From Staging Path
id: a3f4e2b7-71c0-4c93-a3f1-salttyph0001
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects execution of signed third-party utilities (DigitalPersona dthelper.exe, K7 Computing
  K7SysMSI.exe / K7TSecurity.exe, Kaspersky avp.exe, Trend Micro rc.exe, VMware vftrace.exe)
  abused by Earth Estries / GhostEmperor (Salt Typhoon, MITRE G1045) to side-load DEMODEX,
  GHOSTSPIDER, SNAPPYBEE, and ZINGDOOR loaders from non-default ProgramData / Public / Temp
  staging paths.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/k/earth-estries.html
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.t1027
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\dthelper.exe'
      - '\k7sysmsi.exe'
      - '\k7tsecurity.exe'
      - '\avp.exe'
      - '\rc.exe'
      - '\vftrace.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
  filter_legit_install:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
  condition: selection_image and selection_path and not filter_legit_install
falsepositives:
  - IT-deployed vendor utility installed to a non-default path (rare; verify with software inventory)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\dthelper.exe OR *\\DTHelper.exe OR *\\DTHELPER.EXE) OR @Image:(*\\k7sysmsi.exe OR *\\K7SysMSI.exe OR *\\K7SYSMSI.EXE) OR @Image:(*\\k7tsecurity.exe OR *\\K7TSecurity.exe OR *\\K7TSECURITY.EXE) OR @Image:(*\\avp.exe OR *\\AVP.exe OR *\\Avp.exe) OR @Image:(*\\rc.exe OR *\\RC.exe) OR @Image:(*\\vftrace.exe OR *\\VFTrace.exe OR *\\vftrace.EXE)) (@Image:(*\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\PROGRAMDATA\\*) OR @Image:(*\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\users\\public\\*) OR @Image:(*\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\windows\\temp\\* OR *\\WINDOWS\\TEMP\\*) OR @Image:(*\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\perflogs\\*)) -@Image:(*\\Program\ Files\\* OR *\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(dthelper|k7sysmsi|k7tsecurity|avp|rc|vftrace)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(ProgramData|Users\\\\Public|Windows\\\\Temp|PerfLogs|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp)\\\\", field=ImageFileName, flags=i)
| NOT regex("\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\", field=ImageFileName, flags=i)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Salt Typhoon (Earth Estries / GhostEmperor / FamousSparrow) is one of the very few state-aligned clusters whose entire post-exploit loader ecosystem (DEMODEX, GHOSTSPIDER, SNAPPYBEE, ZINGDOOR, SparrowDoor) is built around DLL side-loading of these specific signed vendor utilities — repeatedly named in Trend Micro, ESET, and Kaspersky reporting. The path + binary pairing is what makes this actor-sp
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID

ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon NETSH portproxy tunnel-relay into telecom RADIUS/TACACS+/RDP/SMB plane
ucs.description: Hunts for `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4/v4tov6/v6tov4/v6tov6` invocations on Windows admin/mediation hosts where the ConnectPort points at the internal services Salt Typhoon characteristically pivots to from a compromised Cisco-edge foothold — TACACS+ (49), RADIUS (1812/1813), RDP (3389), SMB (445), or SSH (22) — turning a Windows jumpbox into a relay between the public edge and the OSS/BSS network.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="netsh.exe" Processes.process="*portproxy*" (Processes.process="*add v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov6*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=cmdline "(?i)listenport=(?<listen_port>\d+)" | rex field=cmdline "(?i)connectaddress=(?<connect_addr>[\w\.:]+)" | rex field=cmdline "(?i)connectport=(?<connect_port>\d+)" | where connect_port IN ("22","49","445","1812","1813","3389") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let TelecomPivotPorts = dynamic(["22","49","445","1812","1813","3389"]);  // SSH, TACACS+, SMB, RADIUS auth/acct, RDP
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4","add v4tov6","add v6tov4","add v6tov6")
| extend ListenPort     = extract(@"(?i)listenport=(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddress = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress=([\w\.:]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort    = extract(@"(?i)connectport=(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| where ConnectPort in (TelecomPivotPorts)                                          // tie to Salt Typhoon's pivot targets
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ProcessCommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectAddress, ConnectPort,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ParentAcct  = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          IsRemoteSession = InitiatingProcessTokenElevation
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let TelecomPivotPorts = dynamic(["22","49","445","1812","1813","3389"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where tolower(NewProcessName) endswith "\\netsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has "portproxy"
| where CommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4","add v4tov6","add v6tov4","add v6tov6")
| extend ListenPort     = extract(@"(?i)listenport=(\d+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddress = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress=([\w\.:]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort    = extract(@"(?i)connectport=(\d+)", 1, CommandLine)
| where ConnectPort in (TelecomPivotPorts)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName,
          CommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectAddress, ConnectPort,
          ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon NETSH PortProxy Relay To Telecom Pivot Port
id: c91d8f3a-2b6e-4f81-9e02-salttyph0002
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects `netsh interface portproxy add` invocations that forward inbound traffic to internal
  TACACS+ (49), RADIUS (1812/1813), RDP (3389), SMB (445), or SSH (22) — the pivot targets Salt
  Typhoon characteristically chains into from a compromised Cisco-edge foothold to reach OSS/BSS
  systems on telecom networks.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1045/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1572/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1572
  - attack.t1090
  - actor.salt_typhoon
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'portproxy'
  selection_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'add v4tov4'
      - 'add v4tov6'
      - 'add v6tov4'
      - 'add v6tov6'
  selection_port:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'connectport=22'
      - 'connectport=49'
      - 'connectport=445'
      - 'connectport=1812'
      - 'connectport=1813'
      - 'connectport=3389'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_action and selection_port
falsepositives:
  - Network engineer setting up an approved RDP / SMB relay (rare on user endpoints; expected on jump-hosts only)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\\netsh.exe OR *\\Netsh.exe OR *\\NETSH.EXE)) (@CommandLine:*portproxy* OR @CommandLine:*PortProxy* OR @CommandLine:*PORTPROXY*) (@CommandLine:*v4tov4* OR @CommandLine:*v4tov6* OR @CommandLine:*v6tov4* OR @CommandLine:*v6tov6*) (@CommandLine:*connectport=22* OR @CommandLine:*connectport=49* OR @CommandLine:*connectport=445* OR @CommandLine:*connectport=1812* OR @CommandLine:*connectport=1813* OR @CommandLine:*connectport=3389*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i CommandLine=/portproxy/i CommandLine=/add\s+v[46]tov[46]/i CommandLine=/connectport=(22|49|445|1812|1813|3389)\b/i
| ListenPort     := regex("(?i)listenport=(?<port>\\d+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| ConnectAddress := regex("(?i)connectaddress=(?<addr>[\\w\\.:]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| ConnectPort    := regex("(?i)connectport=(?<cport>\\d+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ConnectAddress, ConnectPort, ListenPort, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: While netsh portproxy is a generic LOLBin, the Salt Typhoon-specific angle is the destination port: their telco/MSP intrusions have repeatedly used Windows mediation servers to relay from a compromised Cisco IOS XE edge into TACACS+ (TCP/49), RADIUS (UDP/1812/1813), and admin SMB/RDP. Other crews tunnel for RDP alone; chaining TACACS+/RADIUS as the connect target is virtually unique to Salt Typhoo
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID
